verifications.claim: SpaceX successfully launched a Falcon 9 Block 5 rocket carrying 29 Starlink satellites.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R1: 'A SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket lifts off... The Starlink 10-62 mission features 29 of SpaceX’s Starlink V2 Mini Optimized satellites... SpaceX confirms deployment'; R2: 'A SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket will launch 29 Starlink satellites'; R4: 'Liftoff of the Starlink 10-62 mission'
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly support SpaceX Falcon 9 launch of 29 Starlink satellites with success (deployment confirmed), but do not explicitly mention 'Block 5' version.

verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'the Starlink 10-62 mission'; R2: 'SpaceX Starlink 10-62'; R4: 'Starlink 10-62 mission'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly name the mission as Starlink 10-62.

verifications.claim: The launch occurred on Sunday, March 22, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state the date as Sunday, March 22, 2026.

verifications.reasoning: Sources directly confirm the exact launch site.
